improvement: Class-level data/label audit and rebalancing for zero-TP and confusable classes
problem_addressed: 5 zero-TP classes (1124 GT, 16.7% of test GT); Pliers/Screwdriver, PaintChip/PlasticPart, Wrench/AdjustableWrench overlap pattern (hypothesis)
proposed_experiment: Count per-class training instances; review annotations and class definitions for confusable pairs; add varied examples or class-aware sampling; retrain on same splits with otherwise identical settings
expected_benefit: Hypothesis only: higher recall/precision on targeted classes; NOT measured
risk_tradeoff: Labels may be intrinsically ambiguous; rebalancing may reduce strong-class performance; more near-duplicate frames add little diversity
success_metric: Per-class recall/precision/F1 and mAP50 on validation for target classes; confusion off-diagonals for the pairs; no regression on strong classes; one final test evaluation
evidence_basis: Corrected Step 14B class-wise results + approved Step 14C examples (visual confirmation pending)

improvement: Validation-based per-class threshold calibration and stronger evaluation protocol
problem_addressed: Single threshold 0.25; test recall/precision trade-off (P 0.0987/R 0.6989 at 0.001 vs P 0.5076/R 0.258 at 0.75); official eval arguments unrecovered
proposed_experiment: Save all eval arguments; per-class PR curves on validation; choose operating points for an explicit recall target; freeze; evaluate once on test with bootstrap confidence intervals and report FP per image
expected_benefit: Hypothesis only: transparent safety-oriented operating points; possibly higher recall at an acceptable alert load; NOT measured
risk_tradeoff: Small per-class validation counts; thresholds may not transfer to test or real UAV data; leakage if tuned on test
success_metric: Target recall met on held-out test with reported FP-per-image budget and confidence intervals; threshold selection documented as validation-only
evidence_basis: Threshold diagnostic on test (understanding only) + two examples with very low same-class confidence

problem_addressed: Tiny objects are IoU-sensitive (illustrative arithmetic); real UAV frames likely larger with small debris. Size effect NOT yet established (BoltWasher ~9 px is strong; missed examples are large)
proposed_experiment: Step 1: measure recall by GT-size bin from existing predictions (no retraining). Step 2 only if small objects limit performance: ablate larger input size and tiled inference vs baseline on same splits
expected_benefit: Hypothesis only: gains in the small-object bin if size is the limiting factor; NOT measured
risk_tradeoff: Compute and latency cost; native 300x300 has no extra detail; tiling needs duplicate merging
success_metric: Recall and precision in small-size bins, FP per image, measured latency on the target device
evidence_basis: Approved Step 14C examples and class-level results
